request.deadline: 12 months from deployment; month-6 yield distribution; audit expected by 2026-07-01
deliverables: Deploy treasury-owned capital into Strike Finance V2 USDM liquidity for 12 months.
Return realized yield from the first six months to the Cardano Treasury at month 6.
Return 100% of remaining treasury-owned deployed assets, including principal and realized yield, at month 12, minus any realized losses in wind-down scenarios.

Provide monthly public transparency reports covering deployment status, liquidity utilization, volume, open interest, P&L, yield, drawdown, stablecoin exposure, market quality, distributions, and material risks.
Provide independent third-party assurance reports at deployment confirmation, month-6 yield distribution, and month-12 return of funds.
request.recipient: Independent multisig council composed of Rami from Snek, Phil from Surf, and James from Monetra/Moneta administering deployment for Strike Finance V2.
request.what: 12-month productive treasury deployment into Strike Finance V2 liquidity infrastructure, with ADA sold for USDM to provide stablecoin-denominated liquidity.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 9,000,000 ADA for a 12-month deployment into Strike Finance V2 liquidity infrastructure rather than grant funding.
The deployed ADA will be sold for USDM, modeled at ADA = 0.15 USD to produce approximately 1,350,000 USDM of stablecoin liquidity, with actual notional reported after deployment.

Under modeled assumptions of a 10% USD-denominated APR, the deployment is expected to generate about 135,000 USD or 900,000 ADA-equivalent in annual yield, but the document states returns are not guaranteed.

Strike reports cumulative traction of over 1.13 billion USD in volume, about 968,000 to 1,001,000 trades, over 3,000 unique traders, over 1.16 million USD in protocol revenue, and over 3.25 million USD in liquidity-provider profit.
The document states Strike accounted for over 50% of Cardano trading activity over the past six months.
V2 public data since 2026-03-20 through 2026-06-15 is presented as 87,288,044 USD total volume, 410,800 total trades, 2,681 users, 30,105 USD total revenue, and 1,246,007 USD peak open interest.

The Strike Liquidity Provider vault is described as having 985,271.59 USD TVL, 43.52% APR, +8.85% all-time return, +69,537.24 USD all-time P&L, 1.15% maximum drawdown, and a 4.97 Sharpe ratio over two months.
The proposal says an independent multisig council will administer and control deployed liquidity, and Strike Finance will not have unilateral custody or control of treasury assets.

The document identifies risks including underperformance versus holding ADA, ADA price appreciation risk, USDM depeg/redemption risk, custody risk, liquidity risk, smart contract risk, and yield underperformance.

The proposal states Strike V2 has had unofficial reviews and that Christian Schmitz is conducting an official audit expected to be finalized by 2026-07-01, with the report to be published after completion.

summary: The anchor presents a 9,000,000 ADA, 12-month treasury-owned liquidity deployment into Strike Finance V2 via USDM, with modeled yield, claimed traction, multisig administration, reporting, assurance, and return-of-funds terms, while acknowledging market, stablecoin, custody, smart-contract, and underperformance risks.
